body:
In CMakeLists.txt, the variable `OpenMP_CXX_FLAGS` only carries the compiler flags `-Xclang -fopenmp`

Line 504:

```
if(OPENMP_FOUND)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${OpenMP_CXX_FLAGS} -Werror=unknown-pragmas")
endif()
```

I believe that in macports (and in Linux as well) the omp.h header file is in some standard location which is automatically found at compilation time. With the homebrew ports this header is located in `/opt/homebrew/include/omp.h`

However we don't need to manually pass this directory. The CMake `find_pkg` command takes care of setting the right variables. It seems that the cleanest (and universal) solution would be just adding a `link_libraries()` command, so that the snippet above can be changed to:

```
  if(OPENMP_FOUND)
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -Werror=unknown-pragmas")
    link_libraries(OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX)
endif()
```

This automatically takes care of setting compile flags, include directories and link libraries.

Disclaimer: although I regularly use CMake, I don't know all its options and internals (who does?) so I sought help from my friend Claude.
